blocks.title: The big idea
blocks.body: The heap is memory you ask for with `malloc` and return with `free`. You are responsible for every block.

blocks.title: Block lifecycle
Rules
items: Never use a block after freeing it
Stay inside the size you asked for

blocks.title: Growing a block
items: Double the capacity to copy less often

blocks.body: Compile with -g and run Valgrind where available. Bugs here are undefined behavior, so working code is not proof.
